name: Via Francigena
description_md:
The Via Francigena is a waymarked hiking route in Switzerland that covers 207.1 km. This route involves 5707 m of ascent and 4359 m of descent.

It is part of an international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as 70. The walking time is about 66 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, with a difficulty of hard derived from the distance and ascent. The line matches the official route published by swisstopo. Additionally, the route passes Lausanne within 1300 m and the Cantonal museum of Zoology, Lausanne within 1800 m.
